gcp.monitoring.read_time_series.note: Monitoring read API calls: per time series returned, at least one per call; calls from the console (not Cloud Shell) and write calls are free. The first million time series a billing account a month are free ("First 1 million time series returned per billing account", https://cloud.google.com/stackdriver/pricing), counted over the account. Synced from the Billing Catalog, which lists them as a $0 first tier.

gcp.monitoring.volume.note: Metric volume charged by bytes ingested. Tiers count the billing account's chargeable metric volume in a month: the first 150 MiB are free, then from 150, 100,000 and 250,000 MiB ("First 150 MiB per billing account for metrics charged by bytes ingested", https://cloud.google.com/stackdriver/pricing). Synced from the Billing Catalog, whose Metric Volume SKU lists the free 150 MiB as a $0 first tier.
